title: Perceptron, alive
description: A perceptron drawn as a picture: input nodes send pulses of light along weighted edges whose thickness breathes, the pulses gather in the sum, pass the step drawn inside the activation and light the output. The light keeps flowing while the slide is on screen. Only the symbols you give are written.

props.weights: weight names on the edges, same order, for example ["w1", "w2"]
props.bias: bias name, for example b (a small node above)
props.sum: symbol in the sum node (default Σ)
props.act: name under the activation, for example h(x)
props.eq: one formula under the picture, for example y = h(b + w1x1 + w2x2)
props.title: heading
props.note: one small line under (when there is no eq)
